items.title: What Do I Want to Be?
items.description: In the early days of vocational high school, I didn't dream of becoming anything. I just wanted a stable life and to build a small, harmonious family.

items.title: The Illusion of Comfort
items.description: Because my goals were fairly simple back then, I became a very laid-back person. I went to school just for the sake of it, finished assignments just to get them done.

items.title: The Awakening
items.description: Until it crossed my mind — my youth only comes once, it will never come again. Why am I taking it easy? Am I wasting my youth?

items.title: A New Purpose
items.description: From that moment on, I — who initially wanted nothing — became determined that when I grow up, I will become someone important, someone whose level is far above the average person, and most importantly, someone who can be a blessing to others.

items.title: The Beginning of a Story
items.description: In the end, I am now studying at STIKOM, with dreams, vision, and missions that far surpass who I used to be. Nice to meet you, I'm Alvin Nugraha, a university student who has [flex achievements yadayadayada].
